_comment: kdb+ instances used by the CAS retrospective report.
No username/password is sent -- host and port only.
Each role has an 'ht' (historical, date-partitioned) entry and optionally an
'rt' (real-time / intraday) entry.  Run with --mode rt to hit the RT tapes at
the end of the day before the HDB write-down.
'partitioned': false -> queries omit the date predicate entirely (RT tables
such as the RT qatt have no `date` column).
FILL IN host / port BEFORE RUNNING.  The ports below are placeholders except
for the qatt ones: 17034 is the historical tape and 17031 the real-time one.
Those numbers are ports -- the table itself is called `qatt` on both.
